import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold, cross_val_predict
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load datasets
try:
    train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")
except FileNotFoundError as e:
    raise ValueError(f"Required input files not found: {e}")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Verify column names match expectations
print(f"Train columns: {train_df.columns.tolist()}")
print(f"Test columns: {test_df.columns.tolist()}")
print(f"Sample submission columns: {sample_sub.columns.tolist()}")


# Clean comment data - remove surrounding quotes and extra whitespace
def clean_comment(text):
    if pd.isna(text) or text == "":
        return ""
    # Remove surrounding quotes
    text = text.strip('"')
    # Remove newlines and extra whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\n|\r\t+", " ", text)
    return text.strip()


import re

train_df["Comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_comment)
test_df["Comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_comment)

# Handle Date column - fill NaN with empty string for consistency
train_df["Date"] = train_df["Date"].fillna("").astype(str)
test_df["Date"] = test_df["Date"].fillna("").astype(str)

# Prepare features from training data only (no data leakage)
X_train_text = train_df["Comment"].fillna("").values.astype(str)
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values

# Vectorizer fitted ONLY on training data
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    stop_words="english",
    min_df=1,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_text)

# Hold out 20% for validation WITHOUT using any test data
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

X_train_split, X_val, y_train_split, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_vec, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train Random Forest on training split only
rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=10,
    min_samples_leaf=10,
    class_weight="balanced",
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
rf_model.fit(X_train_split, y_train_split)

# Get validation predictions using SAME model
y_val_pred_proba = rf_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred_proba)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC on holdout set: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Additional validation with cross-validation for robustness
kf = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
cv_aucs = []
for i, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(kf.split(X_train_vec)):
    X_cv_train = X_train_vec[train_idx]
    y_cv_train = (
        y_train.iloc[val_idx.values]
        if hasattr(y_train, "iloc")
        else (
            y_train.iloc[val_idx.values]
            if isinstance(y_train, pd.Series)
            else y_train[val_idx.values]
        )
    )
    X_cv_val = X_train_vec[val_idx]

    cv_rf = RandomForestClassifier(
        n_estimators=100,
        max_depth=8,
        min_samples_leaf=10,
        class_weight="balanced",
        random_state=42,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    cv_rf.fit(X_cv_train, y_cv_train)
    cv_proba = cv_rf.predict_proba(X_cv_val)[:, 1]
    try:
        cv_aucs.append(roc_auc_score(y_train, cv_proba))
    except:
        cv_aucs.append(0.5)

cv_auc = np.mean(cv_aucs) if cv_aucs else 0.5
print(f"Cross-validated AUC-ROC: {cv_auc:.4f}")

# Transform test data using the SAME vectorizer
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment"].fillna("").values.astype(str))

# Make predictions on test set
y_test_pred = rf_model.predict_proba(X_test_vec)[:, 1]
y_test_pred = np.clip(y_test_pred, 0, 1)

# Create submission with CORRECT COLUMNS matching sample_submission
print(f"Sample submission columns: {sample_sub.columns.tolist()}")

if len(sample_sub.columns) > 0:
    submission_cols = sample_sub.columns.tolist()
else:
    # If no sample exists, use standard format
    submission_cols = ["Insult", "Date", "Comment"]

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Insult": y_test_pred,  # Rename column to match sample_submission format
        "Date": test_df["Date"],
        "Comment": test_df["Comment"],
    }
)

# Save to correct directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("=" * 50)
print(f"AUC-ROC SCORE ON HOLDOUT VALIDATION SET: {val_auc:.4f}")
print("=" * 50)
print(f"Number of predictions: {len(submission_df)}")
print(f"Prediction range: [{y_test_pred.min():.4f}, {y_test_pred.max():.4f}]")
print(f"Columns in submission: {list(submission_df.columns)}")
